final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS amount_avg, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_avg FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(amount_avg) AS amount_avg, AVG(balance_avg) AS balance_avg FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) AS amount_avg FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.amount_avg, r.balance_avg, r.amount_avg / o.amount_avg AS ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.amount_avg IS NOT NULL
